scope: All 88 zadovol- predicates in live v019 Latin sources, including 32 source lines whose governed complements required sentence-level repair.
choice: Render formal mathematical satisfaction and fulfilment with the official type-1 izpolnjati/izpolniti family. Recast every dative or relative complement required by the source-shaped zadovol- construction into the corresponding transitive accusative construction.
motivation: Every audited site denotes an equation, condition, law, axiom, relation, or formal object satisfying requirements. The official izpoln- family explicitly covers German erfüllen/ausführen/durchführen and has independent West- and South-Slavic mathematical comparators. Keeping the semantically broader satisfy/please family would preserve an avoidable source-language collapse and its inherited case government.
alternatives_rejected: Retain zadovol- as a universal technical predicate: the official entries also mean please or make content and do not distinguish these 88 formal mathematical uses.
Use dostavati: it expresses impersonal sufficiency, not an object fulfilling a condition.
Replace the root without repairing complements: that would leave 32 sentences with government inherited from the rejected predicate.

official_dictionary.accepted_entries: id 597 izpȯlniti and id 2501 izpȯlnjati, both type 1; id 36609 izpȯlnjeńje
official_dictionary.rejected_entries: id 444 zadovaljati and id 3356 zadovoliti (satisfy/please); id 21715 dostavati (suffice)

official_grammar.relevance: aspect, present-stem contraction, participles, and verbal nouns

independent_math_comparators.west: Czech splňují/splňující and Polish spełnia in independent mathematical bodies
independent_math_comparators.south: Croatian zadovoljavaju, Serbian ispunjava, Slovenian izpolnjuje/ustrezajo, Bulgarian izpŭlneni, and Macedonian ispolneti comparators; the bridge choice follows the official type-1 family rather than raw token voting
independent_math_comparators.east: bounded Belarusian bodies abstain; the official Belarusian column supports the execute/fulfil sense

construction_corrections: The first dry run rejected the evidence handoff's 27 izpolnja / 9 izpolnjaje histogram. The exact sentence-level recast at base line 10286 intentionally contracts zadovoljuje to izpolnja, so the byte-replayed partition is 28 / 8. No source was written by the failed dry run; the correction was made before apply.
